teamBuilding.name: Interactive Forest Challenge
teamBuilding.involves: Teams follow clues through the trees, solve puzzles and cross rope obstacles to win the Forest Flag.

teamBuilding.name: Laser Combat
teamBuilding.involves: Team tag in the bush with laser gear: hide behind trees, capture the flag, cheer loudly.

teamBuilding.name: Adventure Golf
teamBuilding.involves: Nine mini-golf holes themed on Uganda: crested crane, source of the Nile, boda boda, Rwenzori.

teamBuilding.name: Aerial Tree Trekking
teamBuilding.involves: Balance, walk and swing between treetop platforms in a harness, with a guide at every stage.

teamBuilding.name: Field Archery
teamBuilding.involves: Shoot at animal-shaped targets along a shaded forest path.

teamBuilding.name: Fire Building & Campfire
teamBuilding.involves: Learn to build a safe fire, then gather for roasted maize, marshmallows, drumming and stories under the stars.

teamBuilding.name: Silent Trust Walks
teamBuilding.involves: Walk quietly in pairs, one guiding the other with eyes closed, and listen to birds, wind and water.

teamBuilding.name: Football Fun Challenge
teamBuilding.involves: Penalty shoot-outs, dribble courses and a mini-match: kids versus parents.

teamBuilding.name: Foot Golf Challenge
teamBuilding.involves: Kick a football around a golf-style course into big holes. Fewest kicks wins.

teamBuilding.name: Family Challenge
teamBuilding.involves: Families compete in sack races, tug-of-war, egg-and-spoon and a quick trivia round.

teamBuilding.name: Quad-Bike Safari
teamBuilding.involves: Guided ride on dusty trails past farms and trees. Helmets on and safety briefing first.

teamBuilding.name: Chef Academy
teamBuilding.involves: Cook local favourites such as rolex, luwombo or mandazi, then eat your creation.
